stories.title: Violence Erupts as Israeli Settlers Attack Palestinians and Journalist During Olive Harvest
stories.summary: Dozens of masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians during the annual olive harvest in the occupied West Bank, injuring at least two people, including a Washington Post journalist. The settlers reportedly hurled rocks, burned olive trees, and disrupted the harvest in a coordinated effort across multiple villages. The Israeli army stated that the incident will be examined.

stories.title: Tragic Shooting at Oregon Elementary School Claims Lives of Three Children and a Teacher
stories.summary: A shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of three children, aged 5, 8, and 11, along with a teacher. The 16-year-old shooter was reportedly killed by a bystander who intervened during the incident. Two additional individuals were critically injured in the attack, which has prompted discussions on gun control following reports that the shooter used a shotgun purchased by his mother.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV Celebrates Mass in Hospital Following Lung Cancer Surgery
stories.summary: The Vatican has released the first photos of Pope Leo XIV since he underwent surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his right lung. The images show the pope celebrating Mass at Gemelli Hospital in Rome, where he is reportedly recovering well. Doctors have indicated that further tests will determine if the cancer has spread.

stories.title: Harry and Meghan Return to Public Life in Nottingham After Six Years
stories.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle made their first joint public appearances in the UK since stepping back from royal duties six years ago. The couple visited community projects in Nottingham, where they greeted crowds and interacted with children. This marks a significant moment as they seek to re-establish their presence in Britain.

stories.title: Indian Police Detain Cockroach Movement Founder Ahead of Planned Protest
stories.summary: Indian police have detained Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of the Cockroach Janta Party, in preventive detention ahead of a planned protest in central Delhi. This action comes in response to his calls for a demonstration, which defies a court order banning such gatherings. The protest was organized following recent mass detentions and the jailing of two party leaders.

stories.title: Zelensky Criticizes Trump's Diesel Deal with Russia at EU Summit
stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized U.S. President Donald Trump's recent diesel deal with Russia during a European Union summit in Brussels. He expressed concern that easing sanctions could financially benefit Moscow and welcomed the idea of European allies increasing their involvement in negotiations. Zelensky described Russia's approach to peace talks as a 'parody' and emphasized Ukraine's ongoing challenges, including disruptions to its satellite systems.

stories.title: Pastor and Wife Arrested After 200 Patients Found in Poor Conditions at Rehab Centre
stories.summary: In Mpumalanga province, South Africa, police arrested a pastor and his wife following a raid on a church-run rehabilitation centre. Approximately 200 patients were discovered living in dire conditions, with some reportedly found in chains and suffering from sores on their bodies in overcrowded rooms.

stories.summary: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced the formation of an interim administration in the Tigray region, which has recently experienced renewed conflict following clashes between government forces and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF). The interim government aims to prepare for elections within the next six months.

stories.title: Pakistan Initiates School Inspections After Fatal Roof Collapse
stories.summary: Following a tragic roof collapse at a school in Peshawar that resulted in the deaths of 35 individuals, including 34 children, the Pakistani government has ordered inspections of school infrastructure. Families of the victims are demanding justice, claiming they had previously alerted authorities about the roof's poor condition. Initial reports indicate that the collapse may have been caused by weak infrastructure.

The situation escalates amid tensions between Ukraine and external parties regarding calls for a ceasefire.
